note: ROOM 5 PLAYTEST FIXTURES (doc 36 Q111). Named game states a review URL starts from: `?fixture=<id>` restores one exactly as a save is restored. DATA, NOT CONTENT: flag and item ids, a room, pointers to the documents each state is derived from, and what the build has not built. Every fixture is a state the DESIGN reaches; where the build lacks the writer of a flag it sets, `notBuilt` says so. tools/check-fixtures.mjs refuses an undeclared flag or item, an unknown room, and a combination the documents forbid.
